transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I guess… I just don’t want to do much anymore. The things I usually like—salsa nights, church stuff, cooking for neighbors, even going into my shop just to smell the wood—it all feels like too much, or like I don’t care about it the way I used to.
Do you still enjoy things that you used to find pleasurable?

Not really, no. I’ve kind of stopped wanting to do the things that usually keep me going… salsa nights, church gatherings, cooking for the neighbors. Even walking into my shop just for the smell of the wood doesn’t feel the same.
Do you feel sad most of the time?
Yeah… most days. Especially in the mornings. I wake up with this heavy, empty feeling in my chest, and I have to try pretty hard not to fall apart in front of my wife.
How long have you been feeling this way?
About six months, I guess. It’s been going on long enough that it doesn’t feel like just a rough patch anymore.
Are there any activities that you still find pleasure in or enjoy doing?
Not much, honestly. The things I used to enjoy… salsa nights, church, cooking for folks, even just being in my shop with the smell of the wood… it all feels kind of flat now.
Do you often feel guilty or blame yourself for things?
Yeah… I do. I keep going back over every appointment, every change with my wife’s health, thinking I should’ve noticed sooner or done more. Like… a better husband would’ve protected her somehow.
Do you find yourself moving more slowly than usual or feeling restless and unable to sit still?

Yeah… some. Folks at work have mentioned it. Sometimes I’m moving real slow, like my boots are full of wet cement, just picking up a board takes me forever. Other times I just pace around the shop, rubbing my hands, not really getting anything done.
Have you lost a significant amount of weight recently?
I don’t think so. I haven’t really been keeping close track, but my clothes don’t feel much different.
Have you had any thoughts of hurting yourself?

Yeah… I mean, I haven’t… I don’t know. I’ve had thoughts like maybe it’d be easier if I just didn’t wake up. And sometimes I catch myself thinking my family might be better off without me.

I don’t like saying that. It scares me.
Have you experienced any strange or unusual thoughts, like hearing voices or seeing things that others can't?
No… I don’t think so. I mean, I get stuck in my head sometimes, but I’m not hearing voices or seeing things.
Do you feel like you're moving slower than usual most of the time?

Yeah… sometimes. At work, guys have noticed I’m just… slow, like my boots are stuck in wet cement. Takes me forever to do simple stuff.

Other times I’m just pacing around the shop, rubbing my hands, not really getting anything done.
Have you noticed any change in your appetite over the past six months?
I’m not sure. I haven’t really been paying attention to that. Maybe it’s been different some days, but… nothing I can really pin down.
Do you often find yourself fidgeting or unable to sit still?
Yeah… sometimes I can’t sit still. I’ll end up pacing around the shop, rubbing my hands, not really doing anything useful. Other times it’s the opposite, like I’m moving through mud.
Do you usually find yourself pacing around the shop more often than moving slowly lately?

I don’t know if it’s more one than the other. Guys at work have noticed both… either I’m dragging, taking forever to pick up a board, or I’m just pacing the shop rubbing my hands and not getting much done.
Do you usually feel more like pacing around or moving slowly most of the time?

I don’t know… it’s kind of both. Some days I’m slow as hell, like my boots are full of wet cement, just taking forever to pick up a board. Other times I’m just pacing around the shop rubbing my hands, not really getting anything done.
Have you lost any weight since you started feeling this way?
I haven’t really checked. My clothes don’t feel that different, I guess… so I’m not sure.
Have you lost any significant amount of weight since your symptoms started?
Not that I’ve noticed. I haven’t really weighed myself, so… I can’t say for sure.
Have you noticed any change in how your clothes fit since you started feeling this way?
Not really. I mean, they fit about the same as far as I can tell. I haven’t paid real close attention.
Do you usually feel like you are moving slowly or do you feel more restless and agitated most of the time?

Yeah… kind of both, I guess. At work they’ve noticed it more than I have. Some days I’m dragging, like it takes me forever just to pick up a board. Other times I’m just pacing around the shop, rubbing my hands, not really getting anything done.
Do you usually feel more restless and agitated or more slowed down most of the time?

Most of the time… I guess slowed down. Like my boots are full of wet cement. But then I’ll get restless too, just pacing and rubbing my hands, not really doing anything useful. People at work notice it.
